ios.desc:
Y-Pod is a life planner for people who plan in decades and lose track of today. Write down a ten-year dream, step it down to this week, and finish setup with your first step on the timeline, with a time.

Dreams don't happen overnight. They're built daily.

ONE TIMELINE, TODAY TO THE DECADE
• Your to-do list and calendar events side by side, once you connect your calendar.
• Plan by day, week, month, quarter, year and decade. Swipe from today to your weekly, monthly and yearly goals.
• Switch on a to-do's time and it takes the first free slot left in the day, around your calendar events.
• Unfinished from yesterday? Move it all to today, or mark it all done, in one tap.

TYPE IT LIKE YOU'D SAY IT
• "Dentist tomorrow 3pm" lands tomorrow at 3 PM.
• Write an entry again and it picks up the tags you gave it before.
• On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on, Y-Pod drafts the steps under your dream at setup and picks one of your own tags for new entries, on your device. Without it, typed dates and your tag history still work.

JOURNAL, BUDGET AND COUNTERS
• Journal with your own tags.
• Budget you fill in as you spend: limits, bills and debts (Pro, in-app purchase).
• Counters: a countdown to a date, or a count up from one (Pro, in-app purchase).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your entries live on your device and in your own iCloud account, not on a Y-Pod server. 

FREE TO PLAN YOUR DAY
The daily planner, to-do list, journal and tags are free. Y-Pod Pro adds Budget and Counters, as a one-time Lifetime purchase or an auto-renewing subscription. The Yearly plan can start with a free trial for new subscribers. Cancel a subscription any time in your Apple Account settings.

quotes.text:
Hi, this is Ygee, 
and I'd like to share the story of Y-Pod.

Most people believe their big dreams are impossible to achieve, so they settle for less—not because they can’t, but because they feel overwhelmed and disconnected from that distant future.

I felt the same way. It was a struggle juggling multiple apps like notes, to-dos, and calendars to plan my goals. I realized a dedicated app to organize my life goals would not only help me but also allow me to showcase my technical and creative skills.

That’s how Y-Pod was born — to bridge the gap between big lifelong dreams and small daily actions, empowering users to turn their dreams into reality. My hope is that it will help others live their dream lives and, in doing so, make the world a better place.
